name: transition_status
description: Transitions a spec from one workflow state to the next, enforcing the preconditions defined in knowledge/workflow.md. Use this — and ONLY this — to change a spec's status field. Do NOT hand-edit `status:` in frontmatter; the post-tool-use hook will reject it. Allowed transitions: draft→in-review, in-review→approved, in-review→draft, approved→implemented, any→archived.

reason.description: Short rationale recorded in the spec's history block. Required for transitions to approved, implemented, or archived.

blocked_by.description: List of precondition failures, if any.
